title: resourceWorkers
responsibility: Bounds test and native worker concurrency by the managed CPU reservation and partitions memory for child workers.

inputs.name: resourceWorkers.env
inputs.description: Defaults to process.env: the environment record whose HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS (a value that is not a positive finite number gives {}) and HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB are the only values that affect the result, and no other variable is copied into the returned env.

inputs.name: resourceWorkers.maximumWorkers
inputs.description: Defaults to Infinity: a caller ceiling on the worker count, where any value below 1 or NaN throws when HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS is valid. The worker count is max(1, floor(min(HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS, ceiling))), and memory is divided by that capped count.

inputs.name: resourceThreads.env
inputs.description: Environment record read for HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS and the native thread variables CARGO_BUILD_JOBS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS, GOMAXPROCS and OMP_NUM_THREADS, with other variables ignored. A caller thread value is used only when it is a finite number of at least 1, and then it can only lower the reservation-derived limit.

outputs.name: resourceWorkers
outputs.type: { maxWorkers?: number; minWorkers?: number; env?: Record<string, string>; }
outputs.description: Test worker limits: maxWorkers is the capped worker count (at least 1), minWorkers is 1, and env holds HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS set to min(1, the reservation), the four native thread variables (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS, GOMAXPROCS, OMP_NUM_THREADS) each set to 1, and HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB divided by the capped count, floored when the quotient is at least 1 and present only when HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB is a positive number. The result is an empty object when HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS is not a positive finite number.

outputs.name: resourceThreads
outputs.description: Native thread variables CARGO_BUILD_JOBS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS, GOMAXPROCS and OMP_NUM_THREADS, each set to the smaller of the floored reservation (at least 1) and the floored caller value, or to the floored reservation alone when the caller value is absent, not finite or below 1. The result is an empty object when HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS is not a positive finite number.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Invalid test worker ceiling' when HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS is a positive finite number and maximumWorkers is below 1 or NaN; with a missing or invalid HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS, an invalid maximumWorkers does not throw.
